title: PigForge Part Content v1
description: Engine-agnostic part and collision content. Files authored against this schema contain no engine asset references (no Unity Asset GUIDs, no GameObject or scene paths); engines bind their own assets to parts via partTypeId.

frictionCombine.description: Unity's PhysicMaterialCombine, extracted per collider by tools/bple-materials. A pair uses the higher-priority mode (Average < Minimum < Multiply < Maximum); the wheel tyres are Multiply, which is why a tyre slides instead of gripping like its hub.

variantOf.description: Base partTypeId this entry is a skin/variant of. Must reference a declared non-variant part.

variantName.description: Display label for the variant; the renderer falls back to name.

jointConnectionType.description: Original BasePart.m_jointConnectionType: whether this part offers (source), accepts (target), or refuses (none) a weld. Two adjacent parts merge only when neither is none and at least one is source.

jointConnectionStrength.description: Original BasePart.m_jointConnectionStrength: the per-part weld strength enum. The floats live in the original GameData asset (GameData.asset:101-105) and are resolved in code; extracted by tools/bple-joints, never authored. Absent on the three parts with no prefab, which fall back to normal.

jointConnectionDirection.description: Original BasePart.m_jointConnectionDirection: the part-local sides this part may weld on (the client's build-time alignment only snaps on those sides). Extracted by tools/bple-joints, never authored.

canEnclose.description: True only for frames (WoodenFrame/MetalFrame prefabs). CanBeEnclosed is derived as !canEnclose in code, never authored.

attachment.description: Runtime attachment (balloon string, sandbag tie): searched for an anchor part at start of simulation and tied to it with a rope joint (minDistance 0).

suspension.description: Elastic wheel attachment: the original's own joint for a wheel that overrides CustomConnectToPart declares its local Y as a Limited axis held at restOffset by a linear-limit spring (OffRoadWheel.cs:202-220). Extracted by tools/bple-springs, never authored; parts without it keep the rigid axle weld.

powerConsumption.description: Original BasePart.m_powerConsumption (BasePart.cs:162): > 0 makes the part a consumer. While its switch is on it adds this to its cluster's consumption, the denominator of the power factor (Contraption.cs:540-556, :2633-2644). Extracted by tools/bple-power, never authored.

enginePower.description: Original BasePart.m_enginePower (BasePart.cs:164): > 0 makes the part an engine (BasePart.cs:606-608). While enclosed (Engine.cs:61) it adds this to its cluster's engine power, the numerator of the power factor; it never applies force itself (Engine.cs:29,138). Extracted by tools/bple-power, never authored.

direction.description: Which way the build searches for its anchor: up = hangs from the part above it (sandbag), down = floats above the part below it (balloon).

offset.description: Where the rope's anchor sits in the anchor part's local frame; the attached part rests at most maxDistance away from that point.

distanceFactor.description: Scaled rope limit: maxDistance = distanceFactor * (build separation + distanceOffset) + pigDistanceBonus when the anchor is a pig. Mutually exclusive with maxDistance.

stiffness.description: Unity linear-limit spring of the wheel's own joint, in N/m (m_springStiffness; OffRoadWheel.cs:49 default 150, Part_MotorWheel_08_SET serializes 50).

damper.description: Unity linear-limit spring damper, in N*s/m (OffRoadWheel.cs:214, a constant 5).

restOffset.description: The limited axis' rest offset along the wheel's own Y (linearLimit.limit, 0 = hold the build separation).

chainDetonate.description: When it explodes, ignites other charges inside the blast radius. Defaults to true (original TNT chains).

igniteOnImpact.description: False = only the part switch can light it (original AlienTNT ignores collisions). Defaults to true.

chainRadius.description: Blasters inside this radius fire in the same tick (original BlasterTNT chain).

condition.description: Build-time connection marker: the collider is solid only while the original shows its bracket on this part-local side (Rocket.cs:157-160 turns a hidden marker into a trigger). Physics bodies and cell occupancy ignore conditional shapes; drag snapping and connection proximity use them.
